moments.title: Starved Rock State Park
moments.text: A sandstone butte named for a legend of Illiniwek besieged on top of it around 1769, with 18 canyons and 14 waterfalls behind it on 13 miles of trail.

moments.title: Grandview Drive
moments.text: Two and a half miles above the river valley, cut by hand and horses from 1903, which Theodore Roosevelt is said to have called the world's most beautiful drive in 1910, more or less.

moments.title: Havana
moments.text: Lincoln spoke for three hours on top of Rockwell Mound here in 1858, the day after Stephen Douglas had his turn.
